name: Uruwashi no Seimegami Cecil o Sukuu Nakadashi Shinkon Seikatsu! ~Amaete Ii kara... Anata no Kodane o Takusan Shikyuu ni Sosoide?~
original_name: 麗しの聖女神セシルを救う中出し新婚生活！～甘えていいから…貴方の子種をたくさん子宮に注いで？～
source:
Takuma is a descendant of a noble family. One day, his grandfather tells him to infuse his pure spirit into a goddess who is under the influence of evil power. Takuma meets Cecil, who used to be a general in the Warring State Period and was reborn as a goddess. Cecil asks Takuma to purify her body, but he needs to ejaculate inside her and make a baby to purify her body. Like this, Takuma and Cecil's sex life starts now...
